auditlens.reply:
Yes
The practice is fully verifiable from git history alone. Committing the multi-family real-shape corpus and its encodings in a dedicated commit prior to the red test commit ensures an immutable audit trail of test inputs before implementation begins. The model assignments and role declarations are fixed in repository records, and the separation of red, green, adversarial review, and sign-off seats prevents collusion while remaining auditable via git log and signatures. No loopholes allowing bypass of the practice are apparent.
